name: Kalshi
access: Free public REST + WebSocket market data without authentication (per official 'Quick Start: Market Data'). No paid API or subscription required to read markets, orderbooks, trades, candlesticks.
coverage: Public Kalshi KXCS2GAME match-winner and KXCS2 tournament-winner series. Scoped search of open events; market rules must explicitly name TWC 2026. No current Finals contract captured in this repo. Historical Kalshi website example exists but no historical pre-match ask was stored.
poll_plan: GET /events?series_ticker=KXCS2GAME|KXCS2&status=open&limit=200 (bounded pages); for an event naming Thunderpick or pairing two known finalists, GET /markets?event_ticker=... and verify rules_primary/rules_secondary mention this event/year. Capture yes_ask_dollars, yes_ask_size_fp and updated_time; NEVER use last_price as an executable ask.
status: verified public access; open-event discovery scoped (not exhaustive)
notes: Series names confirmed from Kalshi public series API. Category=Esports returned null; the real discovery tag is tags=Esports. This collector currently uses two known series and limits pages/candidate match pairs. Quotes are paper observations only.

name: Polymarket
access: Free public REST market-data API (discover markets, market details, prices and order books, analytics, real-time data). No paid API or subscription required to read markets.
coverage: TWC 2026 Closed Qualifier market verified: event 1000135 (3DMAX vs 100 Thieves). It is closed; its resolution 0/1 values are not pre-match prices. No active Finals ask captured in this repo yet; absence outside the checked query scope is UNKNOWN.
poll_plan: Search q=Thunderpick&events_status=active (first 25), plus the first 60 open counter-strike-tagged events; inspect first 20 historical search hits for evidence of coverage. For active relevant markets, query the free CLOB order book for EACH outcome token; use best ask and size + book timestamp, never Gamma outcomePrices as executable fills.
status: verified historical qualifier coverage; Finals price availability unknown
notes: Gamma event id 1000135: https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/events/1000135. Snapshot checks are scoped, not an assertion that no other markets exist. Fees/void/partial rules differ by market; the full rule text is captured before any paper decision.

name: HLTV.org event + match pages
access: Free public web pages. No API; read match pages line by line. Respect robots/rate limits; HLTV pages are the settlement reference for match outcomes, not for prices.
coverage: TWC 2026 Finals event page + per-match pages once fixtures exist. Group draw TBD as of 2026-09-24.
poll_plan: After the draw: capture each fixture (teams, stage, BoX, scheduled time). After each match: capture final score + map scores from the match page before settling any ledger entry.
notes: Settlement requires the result AND the market's own settlement rule; a result alone never settles a price bet.

name: Liquipedia tournament page
access: Free public wiki pages (APIs available under wiki terms). Cross-check for HLTV results; conflicts must be flagged, never averaged.
coverage: TWC 2026 Finals page: format, prize, participants, results sections. Results TBD as of 2026-09-24.
poll_plan: Mirror the HLTV capture; any score disagreement blocks settlement until resolved.
